beats.say: Ever watched a craps table and had no idea what was going on? Here is the game in under a minute.

beats.say: The shooter rolls two dice, and the first roll is called the come out.
beats.cap: The shooter rolls two dice,|and the first roll|is called the come out.

beats.say: On the come out, a seven or an eleven wins for the pass line.
beats.cap: On the come out,|a seven or an eleven|wins for the pass line.

beats.say: A two, a three or a twelve is called craps, and the pass line loses.
beats.cap: A two, a three or a twelve|is called craps,|and the pass line loses.

beats.say: Any other number becomes the point, and the shooter keeps on rolling.
beats.cap: Any other number|becomes the point,|and the shooter|keeps on rolling.

beats.say: Roll the point again before a seven and the pass line wins. A seven first, and it loses.
beats.cap: Roll the point again|before a seven|and the pass line wins.|A seven first,|and it loses.

beats.say: A winning pass line bet pays even money, one to one.
beats.cap: A winning pass line bet|pays even money,|1 to 1.

beats.say: But here is the catch: the pass line wins only about forty nine point three percent of the time.

beats.say: Paid at even money, that leaves the house an edge of one point four one percent.

beats.say: And the loud bets in the middle are worse. Any seven carries sixteen point six seven percent.

beats.say: Craps feels like pure luck, but every bet on the felt has an edge.
